ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Music of Luciano Berio. Luciano Berio's music and ideas represent groundbreaking, seminal contributions to 20th & early 21st century art music. His works present innovations with respect to the relationship of words and music, musical dramaturgy, virtuosity, orchestration, and notation, all produced through his unique philosophical and aesthetic lens. This seminar offers an opportunity to take an in-depth look at this remarkable body of work.
